visual.description: Deep forest green used as the primary page and hero background throughout the green-themed sections.
Near-black dark background used in the selected projects and work sections as the dominant surface color.
Vivid coral/salmon used for all large display headings and the primary typographic identity of the site.
Warm off-white peach used for body copy, status text, and secondary readable content.
Soft lavender purple used for section headings like 'SELECTED PROJECTS' and accent typographic moments.
Very dark green used as the transparent/overlay nav background at top-of-page state on the green hero.
Coral salmon used for nav text and links in the initial transparent nav state over the green background.
Dark near-black background that the nav transitions to after scrolling past the hero.
Warm off-white used for nav text and status indicators in the scrolled/opaque nav state.
Coral used for CTA buttons like 'Visit website' and interactive call-to-action elements.
Lavender purple used for links and interactive nav elements such as the 'Intro' nav item.
Muted dark purple used for thin border outlines visible on UI overlay frames and grid elements.
Deeper orange-red used as a variant CTA button color visible on 'DISCOVER' and similar action elements.
Dark grey used for subdued or secondary text labels beneath section headings.
